XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Sporadic engine misfiring and engine fault warning light
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | P0011 | PHASE | TIMING | DISTRIBUTION | CAMS | P0012 | MIL | VARIABLE | VARIATOR | IRREGULAR |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Phase variator solenoid valve

  • Fault: Sporadic engine misfiring, with engine fault warning light illuminated

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: P0011 (Camshaft phase advance adjustment 1), P0012 (Camshaft phase delay adjustment 1)

  • Cause: Phase variator solenoid valve blocked

• Action: Clean the solenoid valve of camshaft phase variator no. 1

  • Procedure: After cleaning the phase variator solenoid valve, it is also recommended to replace the engine oil and oil filter

  • Notes: In this case, the solenoid valve of the phase variator was found to be clogged with dirt and cleaning it solved the problem.
    If cleaning the solenoid valve alone does not solve the problems described, replace the solenoid valve itself.
